label.administrable_evidence: Grants are available to State and Tribal Governments for construction or renovations of State/Tribal owned and operated Veterans Extended Care Facilities.
label.match_evidence: The Department of Veterans Affairs participation may not exceed 65% of the total project costs.

alignment_dhhs.rationale: The opportunity is focused on state veterans homes and does not align with any specific DHHS strategic plan objectives.

alignment_dmva.rationale: The opportunity directly funds the construction or renovation of state veterans homes, which aligns with the DMVA strategic plan objective to modernize the State Veterans Homes infrastructure.
